organizer_conditions: 3 Nov 2026 clarification + organizer reply to this team: every parameter, threshold and model-version choice re-made on other fixtures; public 5-minute window only as a final run check; freeze then regenerate automatically; disclose history in the technical document.
target: Per-frame H/A/D for the supplied tactical recording, ranked by the organizers' spellF1 (possession_metrics.py, vendored unmodified as possession/official_metrics.py).
inference_inputs: tactical ATD metadata XML (team of each track slot, pitch size, frame rate)
tactical ATD raw positions (x, y of slots and ball)
not_used_in_v2: Smart Tagging (no external validation available yet)
ATD speed channel (recomputed from positions for consistency with external data)

dfl_sportec.source: IDSSE / Sportec Solutions open data, CC-BY 4.0, Bassek et al. 2025, doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04505-y
dfl_sportec.labels: BallStatus=0 -> D, otherwise BallPossession 1/2 -> H/A (provider corrected tracking flags; structurally the same derivation the organizers describe for the ground truth)

metrica_sample.labels: event-derived proxy: possession from Metrica event definitions (team of last on-ball event; changes at opponent RECOVERY), D from BALL OUT end / goal / foul / forced stop to next SET PIECE start; underivable frames X (unscored)

previous_exposure: DFL train/validation fixtures and Metrica games 1-2 were accessed by this team in earlier external studies (D002-D004, D001); they are not described as fresh. Reserved tests: J03WMX never downloaded according to the team's registration; Metrica game 3 exposure status unknown.
domain_gap_policy: External tracking is clean; every training and validation copy is corrupted by possession/degrade.py with parameters sampled from broad ranges around the organizers' published aggregate statistics (ball missing ~41% of graded frames). Nothing is fitted to the supplied match.

validation_protocol.metric: official spell_f1_mean, macro_f1 tie-break, computed per play half with X separators
validation_protocol.selection_score: mean spellF1 over DFL validation copies and Metrica games 1-2 copies (equal weight per fixture copy)

selectable: feature set and degradation ranges (judged on validation only)
decoder costs: switch, out_cost, in_cost, bias_dead
acceptance: Select v2 only if its mean validation spellF1 exceeds both comparators by more than the organizers' 0.04 noise band; otherwise report failure and keep investigating.
freeze_then_test: After freezing features, models, decoder and source hashes: optional retrain of the same configuration on all DFL train+validation fixtures, then a single evaluation on reserved tests (Metrica game 3; J03WMX if obtainable). Test results are reported, never used to change the frozen version.
supplied_match: Only the frozen pipeline runs on it, locally on the team's computer; the assistant never receives its data or outputs beyond pass/fail validator summaries; no output-versus-video comparison.
